briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google race toward agentic systems as China accelerates open-source releases

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensified in August 2026 with frontier labs pushing multi-agent capabilities. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous systems. Prompt injection and supply-chain risks dominate security discussions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with advanced tool-use; Anthropic launched Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind unveiled Gemini 3; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B; xAI shipped Grok-3; DeepSeek-R2 matched GPT-4.5 performance at lower cost. Agentic workflows are now the primary battleground.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reached 2.4M units; Microsoft and Google announced 50GW additional data-center capacity; TSMC 2nm AI chips entered volume production; Saudi Arabia committed $40B to sovereign AI infrastructure.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models from China close the capability gap with Western labs before 2027?
